value_policy.rationale: The unchanged upstream order-0 fallback for zswap in thp_swapin_suitable_orders is the control. Require at least 5% useful gain beyond calibrated noise with passing guards.

selected_idea.bottleneck: When mTHP folios are swapped to zswap, Linux disables mTHP swap-in (thp_swapin_suitable_orders returns 0 when zswap is enabled), forcing 16 or 64 independent order-0 faults, repeated allocations, and repeated page table lock acquisitions.
selected_idea.mechanism: In mm/memory.c and mm/zswap.c / mm/swap_state.c, allow high-order folios (orders 2 and 4) when all swap slots in the aligned cluster range reside in zswap, assembling contiguous compressed swap slots into a single high-order folio during swap-in and installing with a single set_ptes() and single page table lock hold.
selected_idea.expected_benefit: Eliminate redundant per-page fault overhead and repeated PTL acquisition during mTHP zswap-in, amortizing decompression and page table installation.
selected_idea.simpler_alternative: Fall back to individual order-0 faults on every subpage as upstream currently does.
selected_idea.falsifier: Reject if candidate causes data corruption, slot leakage in zswap, page table locking races, fails correctness gates, or fails calibrated screening.
required_evidence: Exact-tree independent source review including caller contracts
Fresh probe calibration under Protocol Revision 7
selected_idea.no_upstream_reason: The relevant upstream implementation is already in the frozen baseline.
selected_idea.selection_reason: Directly eliminates repeated PTL holds and per-page fault handling by batching high-order mTHP decompression from zswap.

state.reason: No persistent stored kernel state added.

lifetime.reason: Folio and swap slot lifetime contracts preserved.

locking.reason: Single PTL hold matches existing anon THP swapin.

error_paths.reason: Standard fallback to order-0 on partial decompression failure.

configuration.reason: Uses existing transparent THP sysfs configuration.

test_burden.reason: Requires verifying mTHP zswap decompression, partial zswap presence, and PTL batching.

interfaces.reason: Kernel swapin and zswap interface signatures maintained.

memory_cost.reason: Allocates mTHP folios only when all slots reside in zswap.
